name: CorvoWP Funnel Insights for WooCommerce
author: CorvoWP

sections.description:
CorvoWP Funnel Insights for WooCommerce helps store owners understand where shoppers drop out of the buying journey and where potential revenue may be lost.

Track product views, add-to-cart activity, cart visits, checkout starts, purchases and abandoned carts from a clear WooCommerce analytics dashboard without adding third-party analytics scripts to the storefront.

Free Features

✅ WooCommerce revenue and store activity dashboard
✅ 7-day and 30-day activity trend reporting
✅ Session-unique conversion funnel tracking
✅ Track product views, add-to-cart activity, cart visits, checkout starts and purchases
✅ Abandoned cart tracking
✅ Estimated lost cart value
✅ Product engagement and exit-point reporting
✅ Top abandoned product reporting
✅ WooCommerce order analytics
✅ Failed-order reporting
✅ WooCommerce Classic and Blocks cart and checkout support
✅ Server-side purchase attribution
✅ Optional multi-currency reporting in the store’s configured currency
✅ Local pseudonymous analytics storage
✅ Configurable raw-data retention and deletion controls
✅ Consent-aware visitor journey tracking

Use the dashboard to see how shoppers move through your store, identify where they leave the purchase journey and understand which abandoned carts may represent lost revenue.

Premium Add-on

For stores that need more detailed journey analysis and reporting, a separate CorvoWP Funnel Insights Premium add-on is available.

CorvoWP Funnel Insights Premium adds features including:

✅ Detailed individual customer journey reports
✅ Advanced journey and funnel diagnostics
✅ Deeper session-level analytics
✅ Additional reporting insights
✅ CSV data export
✅ Premium licensing and updates

The Premium add-on is separate from the free WordPress.org plugin. The free version remains fully functional without purchasing or installing the Premium add-on.

Upgrade to Funnel Insights Premium

Learn more about CorvoWP

Privacy

CorvoWP Funnel Insights stores pseudonymous ecommerce analytics locally on the WordPress site after the configured statistics-consent signal is available.

Tracked data may include a random session identifier, page type, product ID, event type, cart amount, currency and timestamps. The plugin does not intentionally collect shopper names, email addresses, raw IP addresses, payment card details, browser fingerprints, form contents or full visited URLs.

Basic WooCommerce order analytics use WooCommerce’s own order data. Store managers may explicitly enable administrator-session testing for their own session.

Raw behavioural data is automatically deleted after the configured retention period. Daily aggregated statistics may remain. The plugin also includes an option to delete its stored data when the plugin is uninstalled.

Site owners are responsible for disclosing their use of analytics and configuring consent where required.

External Services

Multi-currency reporting is optional and disabled by default.

When enabled, CorvoWP Funnel Insights retrieves exchange rates from Frankfurter v2 (https://frankfurter.dev/) using WordPress background tasks. These requests do not run during storefront or checkout requests.

The request includes the WooCommerce configured currency code and a generic plugin User-Agent. Visitor, session, cart, order and customer data is not deliberately sent to the exchange-rate service.

Service documentation: https://frankfurter.dev/
License and provider terms: https://frankfurter.dev/license/

The free plugin does not contact CorvoWP for licensing or plugin functionality.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload and activate CorvoWP Funnel Insights for WooCommerce.
  3. Open CorvoWP Funnel Insights > Settings and configure raw-data retention and the abandoned-cart inactivity period.
  4. To enable public visitor journey tracking, install WP Consent API and configure one compatible consent manager with a Statistics category, such as Complianz or WPConsent.
  5. Enable optional multi-currency reporting if shoppers use currencies other than your WooCommerce store currency.
sections.changelog:
1.0.25

  • Add a direct Premium pricing link to the plugin readme.
  • Add an Upgrade to Premium action link on the WordPress Plugins screen.

1.0.24

  • Use unique plugin-specific identifiers, including classes, hooks, options and analytics table names.
  • Preserve existing settings and analytics when upgrading from the previous prefix.

1.0.23

  • Rename the Free plugin and text domain to CorvoWP Funnel Insights for WooCommerce.
  • Update the separate Premium add-on dependency to the new Free plugin slug.

1.0.22

  • Address Plugin Check SQL-identifier preparation, translation comments and admin notice input handling without changing storefront tracking.

1.0.21

  • Finalise the Free and Premium distribution split and clarify consent-manager setup.
  • Explicitly document the optional external exchange-rate service and its terms.

1.0.17

  • Make WP Consent API optional while keeping WooCommerce as the only required plugin.
  • Keep visitor tracking disabled until a compatible consent configuration is available.

1.0.16

  • Add a consent-manager setup panel to the Funnel Insights Dashboard and Settings screens.
  • Keep public visitor tracking disabled when no compatible consent manager is detected.
  • Use the standard Statistics consent category for pseudonymous journey tracking.

1.0.15

  • Initial standalone Free release.
  • Split advanced reports, individual journeys and CSV exports into a separate optional Premium add-on.
